name: CMSB
recent: Cahya Mata Sarawak 在2026财年第二季度恢复盈利，主要受水泥和房地产开发业务改善带动，抵消了Oiltools业务的疲软。公司近期还涉及与股东Abu Bekir的诉讼，法院已批准其部分查阅财务记录，但公司获得临时暂缓令。此外，审计委员会和董事会成员出现变动。
notable: 2026财年第二季度恢复盈利，主要由于水泥和房地产开发业务表现改善。
法院部分批准股东Abu Bekir查阅公司财务记录，但公司获得临时暂缓令。
审计委员会和董事会成员出现变动，Gee Siew Yoong 和 Jeyabalan A/L S.K. Parasingam 有职务调整。
risks: 与股东Abu Bekir的诉讼仍在进行，法院已部分批准其查阅财务记录，公司获得临时暂缓令。
earnings: 2026财年第二季度营收为2.9197亿令吉，环比增长4.9%，同比增长18.2%；净利润为2244.1万令吉，环比下降6.8%，净利润率为7.7%，低于上一季度的8.6%。

recent_en: Cahya Mata Sarawak returned to profitability in Q2 FY2026, mainly driven by better cement and property development performance, offsetting weakness in the Oiltools business. The company is also involved in litigation with shareholder Abu Bekir, with the court partially granting his request to inspect financial records, but the company obtained an interim stay. Additionally, there were changes in the audit committee and boardroom.
notable_en: Returned to profitability in Q2 FY2026, mainly due to improved cement and property development performance.
Court partially granted shareholder Abu Bekir's request to inspect financial records, but the company obtained an interim stay.
Changes in audit committee and boardroom, with adjustments in roles for Gee Siew Yoong and Jeyabalan A/L S.K. Parasingam.
risks_en: Ongoing litigation with shareholder Abu Bekir; court partially granted his request to inspect financial records, and the company obtained an interim stay.
earnings_en: Q2 FY2026 revenue was MYR 291.974 million, up 4.9% QoQ and 18.2% YoY; net income was MYR 22.441 million, down 6.8% QoQ, with net margin at 7.7% versus 8.6% in the previous quarter.
